planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and PWM LED uses D9 as explicitly required.
No additional wiring beyond A0 (LDR analog input), D9 (PWM LED output), and D13 (digital output) is specified; no other GPIO/RGB/display/servo/tone/serial receive is requested.
Analog and PWM scale/offset calibration parameters are not provided in the input; the model must handle mapping from raw A0 reading to PWM duty count for D9.
LED brightness control logic, thresholds, filtering, and report/behavior timing are SysML model responsibilities, not electrical port configuration.
No serial protocol requirements were provided in the prompt; serial_channels is left empty.
